beats.label: The study
beats.text: **5,600+** people in **26** countries, tracked with **labeled** water.

beats.label: Fact
beats.text: Daily water turnover ranged from about **1** to **6** **liters.**

beats.label: The twist
beats.text: For a typical man in his 20s, **over** **half** may come from **food.**
beats.note: University of Aberdeen estimate, US/Europe diet

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: These are **averages,** and the researchers set **no** new **guideline.** Your needs vary.
